mapper.select: SELECT cr.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, cr.MEMBER_CODE, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME, cr.APPROVAL_STATUS, cr.PROFILE_IMAGE AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH FROM CREATOR cr WHERE cr.MEMBER_CODE = #{memberCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CREATOR ( OPERATOR_CODE, MEMBER_CODE, APPROVAL_STATUS, JOIN_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CREATOR.NEXTVAL, /* 💡 사용 중인 오라클 시퀀스 명으로 설정 (예: SEQ_OPERATOR_CODE 등) */ #{memberCode}, '대기', SYSDATE )
